title: Billing Plans and Installment Service Charges — RentGuard Renters Policy
content:
A RentGuard Renters Policy is billed on one of four plans — the annual plan, the two-pay plan, the monthly EFT plan (automatic bank draft) and the monthly card plan — but not every tier offers all four. Installment plans carry a service charge on installments after the first.

## Plans offered by tier

| Tier | Annual | Two-pay | Monthly EFT | Monthly card |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | yes | no | yes | yes |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | yes | yes | yes | no |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | yes | yes | yes | no |

## Installment service charges (USD)

| Tier | EFT installment service charge, each monthly EFT installment after the first | Card installment service charge, each monthly card installment after the first | Two-pay service charge, on the second two-pay installment |
|---|---|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | 1.00 | 3.00 | 0.00 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | 1.00 | 3.00 | 4.00 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | 1.00 | 2.00 | 4.00 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | 0.00 | 2.00 | 3.00 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Notes

- HO-4 Starter does not offer the two-pay plan, so its two-pay figure of 0.00 is never billed; HO-4 Premier Plus and HO-4 Signature do not offer the monthly card plan.
- No service charge applies to the annual plan or to installment 1 of any plan.
- Hypothetical example: a RentGuard HO-4 Essential policy on the monthly card plan pays twelve installments; installments 2 through 12 each carry the card installment service charge of 3.00, eleven charges in all, which is 33.00 over the term.
